evidence_summary: Evaluation cycle 37167059106 tested whether v17b label normalization (15-25% purity gains on 1.2k subset) generalizes to 174k corpus. Result: HYPOTHESIS FALSIFIED. At 174k scale, zoom_fine (NMI) degrades >10% for 4/8 representations (ratios 0.83-0.89), hierarchy purity shows no gain (constant 0.4711 — a bug measuring majority-class 'unknown'), legal_area clustering unchanged. The evaluation honestly reports uniform_improvement_or_matching=false. Two code defects found in test harness: (1) hierarchy_coherence purity measures 'unknown' class dominance not embedding quality, (2) zoom_coherence.fine_purity field stores NMI not purity. No production changes proposed; v34 TF-IDF 174k baseline remains accepted. Negative result is valid evidence per constitution.
